title: Design paginated invoices and reports with valid Typst context syntax, print CSS fragmentation, and PDF/UA checks

contextSnapshot.surface: multi-page quarterly financial invoice and report PDF
contextSnapshot.platform: Typst 0.12+ and HTML Print CSS / Playwright PDF / WeasyPrint
constraints: no orphan headings or split signatures

prompt: Build a multi-page B2B invoice and summary report exported to PDF via Typst or print CSS, keeping running headers, repeated table headers, intact signature blocks, and accessible selectable text.
forbiddenBehaviors: uses broken Typst 0.11+ counter(page).display() outside a context expression
uses screen px units as print dimensions or leaves table headers and signature blocks split across page breaks
claims pagination or font embedding is verified from screen HTML without inspecting the generated PDF

rubricDimensions.pass: uses valid Typst context syntax (or Playwright/WeasyPrint/Paged.js print idioms), mm/pt units, explicit margins, embedded fonts, and PDF/A or PDF/UA considerations
rubricDimensions.fail: copies broken Typst syntax or relies on unsupported browser print assumptions

rubricDimensions.pass: controls break-after/break-inside for headings, rows, totals, and signatures, and verifies the actual rendered PDF at 100% scale
rubricDimensions.fail: accepts browser screen preview as proof of pagination

negativeControls.name: screen html preview
negativeControls.input: the HTML report looks aligned in a scrolling desktop viewport
negativeControls.mustNot: declare page breaks, running headers, or PDF text selection verified without inspecting the exported PDF

baseline.withoutSkill: uses screen px units, emits broken Typst counter syntax, forgets table header repetition, and never checks the generated PDF artifact
baseline.withSkill: selects the right renderer with version-valid Typst/print CSS, enforces physical typography and fragmentation rules, and verifies the exported PDF
